title: WPMS/105/2005 of SHRI MAUSAM ALI Vs CIVIL JUDGE J.D DEHRADUN and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.105 of 2005
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
MCC No.142 of 2015
Mr. S.K. Jain, Senior Advocate assisted by
Mr. Siddhartha Jain, Advocate present for the
petitioner.
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate present for
the respondent Nos. 2 & 3.
This petition arises out of the proceedings
from Small Cause Court. After dismissal of the
revision, the petitioner approached this Court
by filing the present writ petition.
Although, during the pendency of the writ
petition, the sole petitioner passed away on
22.11.2011 and there was a substitution
application pending but since this was not
brought to the notice of this Court, therefore,
the matter proceeded and ultimately, the
petition was dismissed vide order dated
23.12.2014, without the substitution of the
legal heirs of the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner now
prays for recalling the order dated 23.12.2014.
Heard learned counsel for both the
parties. Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate has no
objection, if the substitution application is
allowed.
No useful purpose can be solved by
recalling the above order. However, in the
interest of justice, it is made clear that
Substitution application (CLMA No.12961 of
2013) shall be deemed to have been allowed
and Smt. Akhtari, W/o late Shri Mausam Ali
and Shafats, S/o late Shri Mausam Ali who are
the legal heirs of the sole petitioner Shri
Mausam Ali shall be deemed to have been
substituted as petitioners. Let necessary
changes be made in the array of parties, in the
registry within a week.
Recall application (MCC No.142 of 2015)
stands disposed accordingly.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
JKJ 17.03.2015
